summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Fidelity International Multifactor ETF (FDEV) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the Fidelity International Multifactor index. The fund tracks a multi-factored index of developed ex-US companies. FDEV was launched on Feb 26, 2019 and is issued by Fidelity.

holdings.infoBox: FDEV is an equity ETF with a total of 218 individual holdings. The top holdings are Daito Trust Construction stock at 1.76%, ASML Holding at 1.65%, Shell at 1.64%, Klépierre at 1.63%, and Hongkong Land Holdings at 1.61%.
